doc:
H: an accepted-but-did-nothing result ("Maren is 72 m away — too far to
talk to; nothing was said") never reaches the brain today (only failures and
movement do), so Dufus repeats speak_to into the void. Shown as a Sense
line, he does something else (walks toward her or carries on).

samples.thought: I see Maren nearby and I need to tell her about the new donut flavor, but she is too far away to speak to yet.
Maren is standing right there in the square, and I have a juicy donut rumor to share, so I will walk over to her to chat.
I see Maren nearby but she is too far to talk to; I need to walk closer to her to deliver my news about the donut shop.

Maren is about 10 meters away, which is too far to speak to directly; I need to get closer to her to deliver the news about the donut shop.

I see Maren nearby and remember I need to tell her about the donut flavor, so I will walk over to her to start a conversation.
Maren is standing right there in the square, and I have a donut secret to share!

samples.message: Hey Maren! The donut shop has a new flavour! Isn't that exciting? What is it?
